title: Hamilton wins a rain-soaked Japanese Grand Prix
description: Lewis Hamilton won at Fuji Speedway in difficult wet conditions, strengthening his championship lead during his rookie Formula 1 season.

title: Häkkinen wins at Indianapolis
description: Mika Häkkinen won the United States Grand Prix at Indianapolis, taking one of the final victories of his Formula 1 career.

title: Schumacher wins in Shanghai
description: Michael Schumacher won the Chinese Grand Prix, drawing level on championship points with Fernando Alonso late in the 2006 title fight.

title: Ferrari's long drivers' title wait ends
description: Michael Schumacher won the Japanese Grand Prix at Suzuka and secured Ferrari's first Formula 1 Drivers' Championship since 1979.

title: Räikkönen charges from 17th to win at Suzuka
description: Kimi Räikkönen produced one of the era's most memorable recovery drives, passing Giancarlo Fisichella on the final lap to win the Japanese Grand Prix.

title: Senna seals a third world championship
description: Ayrton Senna secured his third Formula 1 Drivers' Championship at the Japanese Grand Prix in Suzuka.

title: Hamilton takes the title on the final corner
description: Lewis Hamilton secured his first world championship at Interlagos after moving into the required fifth position in the closing moments of the Brazilian Grand Prix.

title: Russell takes his first Formula 1 victory
description: George Russell won the São Paulo Grand Prix, leading a Mercedes one-two and claiming the first Grand Prix victory of his Formula 1 career.

title: A championship decided in Abu Dhabi
description: Max Verstappen won the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix and secured his first Formula 1 Drivers' Championship after a late-race restart.
